scripts.repo:static: pnpm exec biome check . && pnpm exec markdownlint-cli2 "*.md" ".github/*.md" ".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**/*.md" "docs/**/*.md" "apps/**/*.md" "jobs/**/*.md" "packages/**/*.md" "configs/**/*.md" "infra/**/*.md" "#docs/**/archive/**" "#apps/campus-web/.generated/**" "#**/dist/**" "#**/vendor/**" "#**/node_modules/**" && pnpm exec editorconfig-checker -no-color -disable-indentation -disable-indent-size -exclude '(^|/)(dist|node_modules|vendor|\.tmp|\.worktrees|public/vendor|drizzle/meta)(/|$)'
scripts.docs:check: pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-frontmatter.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-adr-ids.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-links.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-language.ts

scripts.ci:eval: turbo run typecheck test --filter=eval-langfuse --concurrency=1 --summarize && turbo run test:eval --filter=ragas-runner --concurrency=1 --summarize
scripts.ci:go: turbo run native:format native:lint native:typecheck native:test --filter=execution-control --concurrency=1 --summarize

scripts.ci:rust: turbo run native:format native:lint native:typecheck native:test --filter=ingestion-kernels-rs --concurrency=1 --summarize
scripts.ci:typescript:full: turbo run typecheck test --only --concurrency=1 --summarize && pnpm ci:worker && pnpm --dir apps/ops-web build
scripts.ci:worker: pnpm web:test:worker && pnpm exec turbo run build:worker --filter=app-api --concurrency=1 && pnpm exec turbo run build:app --filter=campus-web --concurrency=1
